title: Integrations
subtitle: Connect your self-hosted apps to centralize recipes, menus, shopping and calendar.

modal.encrypted: Credentials are AES-256 encrypted and stored on your server only.

mealie.description: Import your recipes and menus from your self-hosted Mealie instance.

tandoor.description: Import your recipes from Tandoor, the open-source manager.

homeassistant.description: Sync your shopping list with the Home Assistant list.

grocy.description: Sync your shopping list and stock from Grocy.

nextcloud.description: Import your Nextcloud calendar events into your appointments.

immich.description: Show random photos from your self-hosted Immich library as the kiosk display background.
immich.keyPlaceholder: From Immich > Account settings > API keys

outside.title: Also connects with
outside.subtitle: Set up from the other app, or in Settings.

gladys.name: Gladys Assistant
gladys.desc: The family calendar, the shopping list and the tasks in Gladys, the open-source home assistant. Installed from the Gladys integration store, with an API token made in Settings.

api.name: Home Assistant, n8n, scripts
api.desc: A documented API, personal tokens and webhooks: your automations read the family's day and add to its lists.

calendars.name: Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook
calendars.desc: Subscribe to the family calendar from any calendar app, or follow theirs in OpenFamily.

displays.name: E-paper frames and wall screens
displays.desc: A page of the family's day that needs no sign-in, for an e-paper frame, an e-reader or any screen.

ai.name: Ollama and AI providers
ai.desc: An optional assistant, with a local model or an OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Claude or Google Gemini API.

sso.name: Single sign-on
sso.desc: Sign in with Authentik, Keycloak, Pocket ID or any OpenID Connect provider. Set up on the server.
